Privacy

How the LT Automart website handles your information.

WhatsApp for a quoteCall 012-716 6110

Open daily, 10am–8:30pm

What we collect

This website has no forms and no accounts. When you tap WhatsApp or call, you contact us directly in that app, and we only use what you send us to reply to you.

Tap counter

We count taps on our WhatsApp, call, map and social buttons to see which buttons help. The count stores the page and the button, with a random visit code. It does not store your name, number or IP address.

Maps and links

The map on our contact page is a Google Maps embed. Links to Google Maps, Waze, Facebook and TikTok open those services, which have their own privacy policies.

Contact

Questions about your information: WhatsApp us at 012-716 6110.
